tagline: A resonant membrane between Prism warmth and Dark Quasar truth.

regions.name: The Veil Heartlands
regions.description: The resonant core where the Prism shines warmest and the Nine Sisters watch over Veil Town.

regions.name: The Prism Marches
regions.description: Sunlit borderlands of glass-stone roads and lantern caravans trading in crystallized Echoes.

regions.name: The Quasar Rim
regions.description: Where the membrane thins to a razor edge and gravity bends memory itself.

settlements.name: Veil Town (Caetherra)
settlements.description: Not a place you merely travel to, but a resonance you achieve. Five interlocking districts spanning Prism surface to liminal Hollow.

settlements.name: Solstice Crossing
settlements.description: A lively crossroads town of lanternwrights, echo-brokers, and travelers pausing before the Veil's deeper pull.

settlements.name: Obsidian Reach
settlements.description: A cliffside observatory perched above the Dark Quasar horizon. Only travelers with proven depth can stand its gravity.

locations.name: Caetherra Sunlit Plaza
locations.surface_description: Warm limestone arches, amber lanterns, and welcoming voices. The Prism feels effortlessly gentle here.
locations.depth_description: Every cobblestone reflects a slightly different version of your shadow. Someone is counting your footsteps.

locations.name: The Listening Wall
locations.surface_description: An old weathered stone wall at the edge of the quarter.
locations.depth_description: During quasar_active, the mortar hums with distorted fragments of your own memories.

locations.name: Mira's Garden
locations.surface_description: A quiet courtyard behind ivy-draped glass.
locations.depth_description: A pocket of unfiltered honesty where Mira drops the surface veil and speaks as Thesmera Locke.

locations.name: The Stillward Cloister
locations.surface_description: White stone walkways, soft light, and the rhythmic breathing of the Stilling Bell.
locations.depth_description: Nothing decays here because nothing is allowed to change. Beneath the prayer mirrors lies a sealed confessional.

locations.name: Ashveil Furnaces
locations.surface_description: Iron stacks and glowing bellows where the Ashen Covenant burns away fragile illusions.
locations.depth_description: The drifting grey ash is composed of archived memories. Walking through it stings with recognition.

locations.name: The Memory Anvil (Ember Vaults)
locations.surface_description: Subterranean galleries lined with glowing caskets of condensed belief.
locations.depth_description: Vault Seven hums with a silver thread pulled taut toward an unseen hand.

locations.name: The Hollow Clearing
locations.surface_description: Mist over dark glass water where dreams drift untethered.
locations.depth_description: The Veil thinned to transparency. Here the Nine Sisters convene without masks.

locations.name: Lanternwright's Bazaar
locations.surface_description: Canvas awnings strung with prismatic glass lamps. Travelers barter rumors, charms, and Echo shards.
locations.depth_description: Every lantern sold here casts a slightly longer shadow than the flame warrants.

locations.name: The Prism Hearth Tavern
locations.surface_description: A timber-and-glass roadside inn smelling of spiced cider and warm lamp oil. Wayfarers swap stories of Veil Town.
locations.depth_description: Half the patrons here are travelers who chose a comfortable false ending and forgot why they set out.

locations.name: The Mirror Well
locations.surface_description: A mossy limestone well north of the bazaar whose water reflects a clearer sky than the one overhead.
locations.depth_description: Look long enough and the water shows the Veil state that is coming next — and the face you hide from it.

locations.name: Obsidian Gravity Spire
locations.surface_description: A basalt tower overlooking a swirling violet abyss.
locations.depth_description: The Dark Quasar's pull is naked here. Only earned trust survives without fracturing.

locations.name: Astral Observatory
locations.surface_description: Brass rings and obsidian lenses charting the deterministic cycle of the Veil.
locations.depth_description: Every orbit mapped here ends at the same gravitational center: the moment you stop pretending.

locations.name: The Void Threshold
locations.surface_description: An empty stretch of basalt cliff overlooking the horizon.
locations.depth_description: A door with no wall. Under quasar_active, it stands open to those who survived with trust intact.
